name: Hand of Vecna

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book. Artifact random properties use the game's condensed tables (deviations.md).

powers.name: Cold touch
powers.text: A melee spell attack with your spell attack bonus: 2d8 Cold.

summary: Vecna's hand: Strength 20, a freezing touch, and dreadful spells (DC 18), for one who cuts off their own hand.
text: To attune to this artifact, you must lop off your left hand at the wrist and press the artifact against the stump. The Hand grafts itself to your arm and becomes a functioning appendage. While attuned, your Strength score is 20, and any melee spell attack you make with the Hand deals an extra 2d8 Cold damage on a hit. You can cast each of the following spells (save DC 18) from the Hand once per dawn: Finger of Death, Sleep, Slow and Teleport. The Hand has one minor beneficial, one major beneficial, one minor detrimental and one major detrimental property.
